主要内容: On May 10, 2016, SanDisk Corporation (NASDAQ: SNDK) announced it had received final regulatory approval from China's Ministry of Commerce to complete the acquisition by Western Digital Technologies, Inc., a subsidiary of Western Digital Corporation. This approval satisfies the final regulatory condition for the merger, which is expected to close on May 12, 2016. Sanjay Mehrotra, president and CEO of SanDisk, expressed satisfaction with the regulatory clearance and emphasized the company's commitment to supporting Western Digital's transformation into a leading storage solutions provider. The transaction was previously approved by stockholders at a special meeting on March 15, 2016. SanDisk Corporation also announced that the effective date of its merger with Western Digital Corporation is expected to be May 12, 2016. The merger involves SanDisk merging with Schrader Acquisition Corporation, a subsidiary of Western Digital Technologies Inc. The agreement was signed on October 21, 2015, under the Merger Agreement. Following the merger, SanDisk will become a wholly-owned indirect subsidiary of Western Digital. The merger is part of SanDisk's restructuring efforts and is expected to impact its financial and operational structure. Securities explicitly mentioned in the source include Western Digital Corporation (WDC).
